title: Final Inspections, Walkthrough & Move-In

stage.name: Home
stage.description: Inspected, approved and ready. Keys in hand, you move in.

intro: A finish line that's really a beginning.

questions.prompt: What does a certificate of occupancy mean?
options: The house passed inspection and is approved to live in
questions.why: It's the official “ready”: safe to move in.

questions.prompt: Put the last steps in order.
items: Walkthrough and a list of small fixes

questions.prompt: A punch list is a list of small fixes to finish before the job is called done.
questions.why: Even well-built houses have a few touch-ups at the end.

questions.prompt: What keeps a home in good shape for years?
options: Regular care and repairs, done together
Expecting it never to need work
One person doing all the upkeep
questions.why: Homes, like relationships, last when both people look after them.

talk: What would “home” mean to the two of you?
